description: Compact index of every story ever allocated. Keep entries even if a story is retired; IDs are never reused.

stories.title: The Rent Went Up
stories.premise: Woman suspects roommate of skimming rent; he has secretly covered her share of a rent increase.
stories.centralConflict: Pride and fear of being used vs. well-meant secrecy.
secrets: gave up a flat to stay
stories.twistMechanism: Real evidence misread (misdirection through ambiguous clues); suspicion reframed as kindness.

stories.title: Pickup at 3:15
stories.premise: Mom finds ex's girlfriend secretly picking up their daughter; the daughter arranged it to escape bus bullying.
stories.centralConflict: Fear of being edged out vs. secrecy; a child hiding a problem because her parents fight.
stories.twistMechanism: Synced iPad messages reveal the secret-holder is the child; adult scheme reframed as child's workaround.

stories.title: Deposit Returned
stories.premise: Bride discovers the venue deposit was refunded to her fiancé, uncovering a year of hidden gambling debt.
stories.centralConflict: Shared future vs. a partner who managed her instead of telling her.
stories.twistMechanism: Automated-message evidence chain (venue, betting app, lender); the turn is the heroine's decision, not a reveal.

stories.title: Is This Still Ben?
stories.premise: Wrong-number texter searching for her estranged brother; the device owner finds him and learns the sister's complicity.
stories.centralConflict: Honesty with a new love vs. a brother's right not to be found vs. her right to come out on her own terms.
secrets: sister told brother to keep quiet when he came out
stories.twistMechanism: Recycled-number evidence (stranger's misdirected text, repair ticket); turn is the love interest owning a past act.

stories.title: Split the Rental
stories.relationshipType: strangers → couple; consultant / employee in scope
stories.premise: Strangers split a rental in a blizzard; she turns out to be the consultant reviewing his department.
stories.centralConflict: New feelings vs. professional integrity; disclosure costs her the engagement and a promotion year.
secrets: consultant knew six days before telling him
he hadn't told his report he knew her
stories.twistMechanism: All-staff email hook, then choice-driven ethical conflict; no villain.

stories.title: Before 8 A.M.
stories.premise: Feuding upstairs/downstairs neighbours fall for each other; he lied about the noise complaint and is moving away.
stories.centralConflict: Fear of being blindsided again vs. a decent man's small evasions and a love with an end date.
secrets: he lodged the complaint, then denied it
her ex left with three weeks' notice
stories.twistMechanism: Body-corporate record and a misdirected text; small human lies, not big deceptions.
